name: Ikuya
source:
She is one of the heroine’s childhood friends. They were not always in the same class, because she was with her twin brother for a while. But it wasn’t as fun as she thought, so she joined back. Even though she is allowed to keep her uniform, in case she changes her mind. Unlike Lioji, she has more free time and sometimes joins the heroine for a cup of tea and little chitchat.

She is cheerful and a little naïve. Whenever the heroine is troubled, she always rushes to her for help. She likes to tease her friends. Since the heroine is single, she often teases her to find a lovely boyfriend. Maybe she looks innocent and cute, but be careful for her fangs. Physically not very strong, but her words can beat anyone in a discussion.

[From [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/ikuya.html]official site[/url]]
